#!/bin/bash
# Reverse SSH tunnel supervised by supervisord.
# Remote port 9000 -> localhost:22 (this host).
#
# AUTOSSH_LOGFILE : autossh writes its own log output here.
# AUTOSSH_POLL    : health-monitoring poll interval (seconds). Combined with
#                   "-M 0" and the ServerAlive* options below, autossh detects
#                   dead links and respawns ssh.
# AUTOSSH_GATETIME: 0 = keep retrying forever instead of giving up when ssh
#                   exits shortly after a (re)start. Required for a persistent
#                   tunnel in an environment where the peer may be down.

export AUTOSSH_LOGFILE=/var/log/autossh.log
export AUTOSSH_POLL=30
export AUTOSSH_GATETIME=0
export AUTOSSH_LOGLEVEL=7
export AUTOSSH_DEBUG=1

exec /usr/bin/autossh -M 0 -N \
    -o "ServerAliveInterval=30" \
    -o "ServerAliveCountMax=3" \
    -o "ExitOnForwardFailure=yes" \
    -o "StrictHostKeyChecking=no" \
    -o "UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null" \
    -R 9000:localhost:22 \
    tunnel@remote.example.com
